Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:10:1.hebrew: המלוה על המשכון אין שביעית משמטת - דלא קרינא ביה לא יגוש, שהרי אינו תובעו כלום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:10:1.english: One who lends on collateral, the Sabbatical Year does not abrogate [the loan] - For we do not apply to him "he shall not exact [it]," since he is not demanding anything from him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:10:2.english: Only half - Half of the debt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:10:3.english: Does not abrogate - Later [the Gemara] explains it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:11:1.hebrew: אילימא - דאינו משמט כנגד, חצי החוב שהוא תופס משכון עליו אינו משמט, אבל משמט הוא השאר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:11:1.english: If we say - that [the Sabbatical Year] does not abrogate commensurate [with the collateral], [meaning] the half of the debt for which he holds collateral it does not abrogate, but it abrogates the remainder.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:11:2.hebrew: מכלל דר' יהודה הנשיא - אתא למימר דכיון דאינו משכונו כנגד הלוואתו, משמט כל החוב? בתמיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:11:2.english: By inference that Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi - [Does it] come to say that since his collateral is not commensurate with his loan, [the Sabbatical Year] abrogates the entire debt? [This is said] in astonishment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:1:1.hebrew: אלא קשיא - הך מתני' דלוי לריש לקיש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:1:1.english: But [it] is difficult - This baraita of Levi [is difficult] for Reish Lakish.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:1:2.hebrew: ר' שמעון היא - דאמר במתני' לוקח לא מצי הדר ביה, דקסבר מעות קונות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:1:2.english: It is Rabbi Shimon - Who says in the Mishnah [that] a buyer cannot retract, because he holds [that] money acquires.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:2:1.hebrew: מודעינן ליה - דע שאם תחזור, סופך להפרע ממך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:2:1.english: We inform him - Know that if you retract, in the end payment will be exacted from you.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:3:1.hebrew: בעושה מעשה עמך - בעמך דרשינן הכי, והאי לאו עושה מעשה עמך הוא, דכתיב (צפניה ג׳:י״ג) "שארית ישראל לא יעשו עולה ולא ידברו כזב":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:3:1.english: With regard to one who performs an action [befitting] your people - We expound "among your people" thus, and this [person] is not one who performs an action [befitting] your people, as it is written (Zephaniah 3:13): "The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:4:1.english: [The price of] salt increased - And he wanted to retract.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:4:2.hebrew: בר אודועי הוא - בתמיה, וכי היה צריך להודיעו שהוא נפרע מן השקרנים? והלא תלמיד חכם היה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:4:2.english: Is he one to be informed - [This is said] in astonishment: Was it necessary to inform him that He exacts payment from liars? Was he not a Torah scholar?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:5:1.english: A down payment - He gave him a portion of the money toward a large agreed-upon [sum].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:5:2.hebrew: הוא סבר כנגדו הוא קונה - אי מכירת קרקע הוא, שנקנית בכסף, קונה קנין גמור; ואי מכירת מטלטלין הוא, קונה כנגדו להתחייב במי שפרע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:5:2.english: He held [that] commensurate with it, it acquires - If it is a sale of land, which is acquired through money, it acquires [that portion] with a complete acquisition; and if it is a sale of movable property, it acquires [only] commensurate with it, [so as] to become liable for [the curse of] Mi Shepara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:6:1.hebrew: ור' יוחנן אמר כו' - בקרקע לקנין גמור, ובמטלטלין לקבל מי שפרע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:6:1.english: And Rabbi Yochanan said, etc. - For land, [it is] for a complete acquisition, and for movable property, [it is] to receive [the curse of] mi shepara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:7:1.hebrew: הנותן ערבון - לא דמי לההיא דלעיל, דזה אינו פריעת מקצת מעות שקורין אייר"ש, אלא ערבון ומשכון לקנוס את החוזר בו, פרמנינ"ן בלע"ז:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:7:1.english: One who gives a down payment - [This case] is not similar to that [case discussed] above, for this is not a payment of part of the money — which is called erres [earnest money] — but rather a pledge and collateral to penalize the one who reneges, fermenan in Old French.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:7:2.english: Rabbi Yosei [conforms] to his [standard line of] reasoning, as he says - In Bava Batra, in the chapter [entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 168a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:7:3.hebrew: אסמכתא קניא - הבטחת גוזמא שאדם מבטיח את חבירו לסמוך עליו, שאם לא יקיים תנאו, יתן כך וכך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:7:3.english: Asmakhta effects acquisition - [This is] an exaggerated promise that a person makes to his fellow [for him] to rely upon him, that if he does not fulfill his condition, he will give such-and-such.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:1.hebrew: דין שיקנה כו' - לא זה ימחול ולא זה יכפול, אלא לא זה ולא זה יכולין לחזור מלקיים מן המכירה כנגד הערבון, וחוזרים על השאר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:1.english: It is sufficient that he acquire, etc. - Neither does this one [the buyer] forfeit [the down payment] nor does that one [the seller] double [it]; rather, neither this one nor that one can retract from fulfilling [the portion] of the sale commensurate with the down payment, and they [may] retract regarding the remainder.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:2.hebrew: בד"א - שאינו קונה אלא כנגד ערבונו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:2.english: In what [case] are [these] things said - That he acquires only commensurate with his down payment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:3.hebrew: בזמן שאמר לו ערבוני יקון - יקנה. שלא נתנה לו בתורת תחילת פירעון והשאר עליו מלוה, אלא בתורת שערבון זה יקנה את הכל, והא לאו מלתא היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:3.english: When he said to him, "My down payment will effect acquisition [yikon]" - [This means] "will acquire" [yikneh]. For he did not give it to him as an initial payment with the remainder [considered] a loan upon him, rather on the terms that this down payment will acquire the entire [item] — and that is ineffective.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:4.hebrew: אבל מוכר לו כו' - ונותן לו מהן ה' מאות זוז לשם פירעון או סתם, קנה כו'. וההיא דאיפלגו בה רב ורבי יוחנן כי האי גונא הוא, שזה הערבון תחילת הדמים — הפירעון של פיסוק — כי יהב ליה סתם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:4.english: But [if] one sells him, etc. - and he gives him five hundred zuz of them toward payment or without specification, he has acquired [it], etc. And that [dispute] in which Rav and Rabbi Yochanan disagreed is of this kind: that this down payment [is] the beginning of the purchase money — the payment of the stipulated price — when he gives [it] to him without specification.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:5.hebrew: מאי לאו - כי היכי דאמר רשב"ג בקרקע הקנוי בכסף לגמרי, דמכי יהיב ליה מקצת מעות סתם, קנה לגמרי, והוא הדין למטלטלי הקנוים בכסף לענין מי שפרע — בסתמא קני ליה ערבון לכוליה, לחייבו במי שפרע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:8:5.english: What, is it not - Just as Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said regarding land, which is acquired completely with money, that as soon as one gives him part of the money without specification he acquires [it] completely, so too is the law for movable property, which is acquired with money with respect to [the curse of] mi shepara — without specification, the down payment acquires all of it, to obligate him in mi shepara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:9:1.hebrew: ומאי שנא - מטלטלין לענין מי שפרע מקרקע לענין קנין גמור? ומשנינן: קרקע, דיפה כח הכסף בקניינה לקנות לגמרי קנין גמור מלחזור, יפה נמי כח מקצת פריעתו לקנות הכל; אבל מטלטלין, שהורע הכסף בהן, דאי פרע הכל לא קני אלא לקבל מי שפרע, בסתמא נמי לא קני פרעון מקצת לכולו לקבל מי שפרע על השאר, אלא כנגד הערבון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:9:1.english: And [in] what [way] is [it] different - [How is] movable property with regard to "He Who exacted payment" [different] from land with regard to a complete acquisition? And we answer: Land, since the power of money is strong in its acquisition to acquire completely — a complete acquisition [preventing one] from retracting — the power of a partial payment of it is also strong to acquire everything. But movable property, in which [the power of] money is weakened — for if one pays the entire [amount], he acquires [it] only [to the extent of] receiving "He Who exacted payment" — in an unspecified case as well, partial payment does not acquire all of it so as to receive "He Who exacted payment" on the remainder, [but] rather only corresponding to the deposit.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:9:2.hebrew: לא קני ליה כוליה - לקבל מי שפרע, אם נתן לו כנגד ערבונו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 48b:9:2.english: He does not acquire all of it - to receive [the curse of] "He Who exacted payment" if [the seller] gave him [goods] corresponding to his deposit.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:3:1.hebrew: בעושה מעשה עמך - לא מקרי האי אינו עושה מעשה עמך לענין שיהיה מותר לקללו בחנם, כי אם לקללו על המקח הזה במי שפרע:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:3:1.english: "With regard to one who performs an action [befitting] your people" - This [person] is not called "one who does not perform an action [befitting] your people" to the extent that it would be permitted to curse him for naught, rather [only] to curse him regarding this transaction with [the curse of] Mi Shepara.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:4:1.hebrew: רבי חייא ברבי יוסף בר אודועי הוא - דהיה יודע מתניתין, אלא היה רוצה לקבל לטותא קודם שיפסיד היוקרא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:4:1.english: Is Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Rabbi Yosef one who [needs to be] informed? - For he knew the Mishnah, rather he wanted to accept the curse rather than lose the [profit from the] price increase.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:7:1.hebrew: אכפול לך ערבונך - אינו אומר שיחזיר לו כפלים במעות, דא"כ למה יקנה המקח לר"י כנגד ערבונו? אלא אומר: "אכפול לך במקח", שיתן לו כפלים מן המקח כנגד המעות שנתן לו. ר"י אומר: דיו אם קונה המקח על כרחו של מוכר כנגד מעות שנתן, אבל הלוקח אם ירצה לא יקח כי אם מעות, כי יאמר: "איני חפץ במעט מקח":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:7:1.english: "I will double your down payment for you" - He does not mean that he will return double to him in money, for if so, why would he acquire the merchandise according to Rabbi Yehuda commensurate with his down payment? Rather, he means: "I will double [it] for you in merchandise," [meaning] that he will give him double [the amount] of the merchandise commensurate with the money he gave him. Rabbi Yehuda says: It is sufficient for him if he [the buyer] acquires the merchandise against the seller's will commensurate with the money he gave; however, the buyer, if he wishes, need take only [his] money, for he can say: "I do not want a small amount of merchandise."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:8:1.hebrew: בזמן שא"ל ערבוני יקון - רשב"ג מפרש דפליגי ר"י ורבי יוסי שלא נתן לו אותם מעות בתורת פריעה, אבל אם נתן לו אותם מעות בתורת תחילת פריעה — קנה ומחזיר השאר לכ"ע; היינו דלא כרב. ופרש"י: "ערבוני יקון" — שאמר שיקנה לו ערבונו כנגד כל המקח. תימה, דהא עדיף מנתן לו בתורת פריעה דקנה הכל, כיון שפירש בהדיא שיקנה הכל! ואם נפרש "ערבוני יקון" — כנגד ערבונו לבד יקנה לו מן המקח, א"כ לר' יוסי אמאי כופל לו ערבונו? לכן י"ל שלשון "ערבוני יקון" משמע שערבוני יהיה קנוי לך אם אחזור בי, וגם משמע "יקון" שיהא קונה לו במקח שויו יותר מכדי הערבון אם תחזור בך, דהיינו כאילו א"ל בהדיא: "תכפול לי ערבוני":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 48b:8:1.english: When he said to him, "My down payment will effect acquisition" - Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel explains that Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Yose disagree [only] where he did not give him that money as a payment, but if he gave him that money as an initial payment, he acquires [the entire item] and returns the rest [of the money] according to all opinions; this is unlike Rav. And Rashi explained: "My down payment will effect acquisition" — that he said his down payment should acquire for him the entire purchase. [This is] astonishing! For this is even stronger than when he gave [the money] to him as a payment, where he acquires everything, since he explicitly specified that it should acquire everything! And if we explain "My down payment will effect acquisition" [to mean that] commensurate with his down payment alone it shall acquire for him from the purchase, if so, according to Rabbi Yose, why does [the seller] double his down payment for him? Therefore, one can say that the expression "My down payment will effect acquisition [erboni yikon]" implies that my down payment will be acquired by you if I retract, and yikon also implies that it will acquire for him in the purchase an amount worth more than the value of the down payment if you retract — which is as if he explicitly said to him, "You shall double my down payment for me."
